claim_under_test: Fine TFs 2h/1h/30m/15m FIXED by exit-harness + htf_entry_gate; 2020 DEV all cells slice7d>=0.5; frozen OOS 2021 ALL 16 HOLD (slice7d 0.60-0.98) each beating band_off.
overall_verdict: NO-GO as a fine-TF wealth-edge claim; GO-WITH-CAVEATS only as drawdown-insurance
headline_finding: The htf_entry_gate -- the universal lever in 16/16 winners -- has a MATERIAL LOOK-AHEAD. The coarser-TF band-on is aligned by the coarser bar WINDOW-START label, but that bar does not CLOSE until ~1 coarser period later. A fine bar inside the coarser window is gated by information knowable only at the coarser bar close (~coarse/fine - 1 fine bars ahead). W.shift(1) removes only ONE fine bar of this multi-bar leak. Strict-lagging the coarse band-on by one full coarse bar COLLAPSES the result: HMA|1h +879%->+109%, TEMA|30m +2641%->+88%. De-leaked, the engine 7d-slice profit-rate is BELOW dumb always-long in 4/5 cells and its net is a fraction of always-long in every cell. Only maxDD survives (eng -17..-24% vs always-long -67..-70%) = the SAME drawdown-insurance V1 already proved, NOT new fine-TF alpha.

1_HTF_alignment_leak.timestamp_semantics: chimera bar timestamp = jittered CLOSE time; _load_asset floors it DOWN to _FREQ -> a WINDOW-START label. Verified BTCUSDT 2021: 4h raw_close 15:58:21 -> floored 12:00 (delta 3.97h).
1_HTF_alignment_leak.align_htf_on_mechanism: searchsorted(ht,bt,'right')-1 picks the coarser bar whose START-label <= base-t. For a 1h base bar at 12:00 this is the 4h bar labeled 12:00 (window [12:00,16:00)) which closes ~16:00 -> 1h bars at 12:00..15:00 read a future 4h state.

what_v11_actually_is: V1.1 is NOT a fine-TF wealth edge. Stripped of (a) the HTF look-ahead and (b) the bull-flattered absolute >=0.50 bar, the fine-TF engine is the SAME drawdown-insurance property as V1 (coarse 1d/4h) expressed at finer cadence: it halves max-drawdown vs an always-long book by sitting in cash, giving up most of the bull compound. The htf_entry_gate just defers to a slower trend filter (what V1 coarse band already did), and the apparent fine-TF fix was largely the gate peeking at the not-yet-closed coarser bar. The per-cell exit tuning is overfit noise. Capital-preservation, not money-making; not a reason to deploy below 4h.
single_most_important_caveat_to_ship: LOOK-AHEAD in the htf gate: align_htf_on uses the coarser bar WINDOW-START label, so a fine bar inside the window is gated by the coarser bar eventual CLOSE (~coarse/fine-1 fine bars ahead). FIX: shift the coarse band-on forward by one full coarse bar (or align on coarse CLOSE-times, not floored start-labels) and RE-RUN the full 2020 sweep + 2021 iron before any HOLDS_OOS claim is believed. Headline net% (878/2641/5414%) are leak-inflated AND a 2021-bull ride -- never a headline.
